[EN] Greetings, fellow champion. I am Ciebel.

As the walls that once sealed Manahan weaken, creatures from other realms are invading this one.

We must stop them before it is too late.

Do not forget to collect tokens while you are at combat. I will grant a reward befitting your effort.
[ES] Saludos, fellow champion. Soy Ciebel.

A medida que los muros que una vez sellaron Manahan se debilitan, criaturas de otros reinos están invadiendo este.

Debemos detenerlas antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

No olvides recolectar fichas mientras estás en combate. Te concederé una recompensa acorde a tu esfuerzo.
